content.summary: The revised Section 6 now accurately distinguishes structural local proofs, their stated I27 assumption, the external enumerative theorem used by Corollary 4, and exploratory computations. Attribution and assurance are consistent with the source passages directly read in earlier rounds.

checks.method: Read frozen Sections 2 and 5–7; compare the new Section 6 opening with the previously retrieved Proposition 6.7 proof and Section 8 of arXiv v1. No fresh source retrieval or enumeration rerun was performed in this phase.
checks.observation: The manuscript no longer describes all successful conclusions as free of enumerative input: it states that Corollary 4 uses external enumerative I27. It also correctly reserves the no-premise status for its exploratory computations. This matches the external proof dependency. Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.06175v1#S6.SS3.

checks.method: Compare the provenance statements in Corollary 4 and Section 7 with the source formalization scope already read, and check the final paragraph for the stated review limits.
checks.observation: The external theorem retains named authors and a versioned locator; its enumeration is not represented as imported Lean proof. The manuscript labels the local formal theorem conditional, and does not identify autonomous review as independent human certification. The source itself distinguishes finite witness verification from upper-bound exhaustive computations. Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.06175v1#S8.
